notice.title: Open the way out
notice.text: The mill crossing is stuck. Find what is jamming the wheel so the villagers can reach the escape lane.

briar.mara.title: Make room for the wounded
briar.mara.text: Mara needs help treating our neighbors. Find her near the village beds.

briar.supplies.title: Mara’s supplies delivered
briar.supplies.text: Mara has treated the wounded and reopened the large healing pad.

briar.healing.title: Healing pads
briar.healing.text: Mara’s large pad heals you fully and never runs out. Small pads have limited healing. Save them for when you need them.

briar.escape.title: Open the way out
briar.escape.text: The mill crossing is stuck. Find what is jamming the wheel so the villagers can reach the escape lane.
